overview.description: The Global X Morningstar Capital Allocation Leaders ETF (CPTL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a float-adjusted, market-cap weighted index of U.S.-listed companies that are considered to exhibit strong capital allocation practices. Stock selection is based on an assessment of balance sheet strength, investment efficacy, and shareholder distributions. CPTL was launched on Jul 11, 2016 and is issued by Global X.
